svg.text: Flat-02 · distribution board (TPN, 12 ways per phase) in the foyer
From the meter room: 4-core 10 sq mm Cu armoured cable (common rising main)
Phase loads (connected, kW): R 12.5 · Y 12.2 · B 12.2. Spare ways: 11.
Low-voltage (TV, data, door phone) runs in its own conduit to a small network box beside the DB.
